name: Averris: The Riftborn
source:
She is called a flaw in this world's laws, yet only she can rewrite its fate... or become the final victim of its inevitable end.
[From [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Averris:_The_Riftborn]romance-club.fandom[/url]]
translation:
世人称她是这个世界法则中的一道瑕疵，然而唯有她能够改写世界的宿命……抑或沦为世界注定毁灭前的最后一名牺牲品。
[摘自[url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Averris:_The_Riftborn]romance-club.fandom[/url]]
